nodes.name: On New Email (IMAP)
nodes.notes: Watches the IMAP inbox and emits new emails as items (subject, body, attachments). Credential: IMAP credentials. IMAP host, port, user and password from your mail provider.

nodes.name: Gather from MySQL
nodes.notes: Selects rows from the MySQL table (returnAll) — the read side of the store. Retries 3x with 2s backoff before giving up. On failure the item leaves via the error output instead of stopping the run. Credential: MySQL connection. Host, port, database, user, password from your MySQL provider.

nodes.name: Gather from MySQL 2
nodes.notes: Selects rows from the MySQL table (returnAll) — the read side of the store. Retries 3x with 2s backoff before giving up. On failure the item leaves via the error output instead of stopping the run. Credential: MySQL connection. Host, port, database, user, password from your MySQL provider.

nodes.name: Blend Sources
nodes.notes: Rejoins 2 branches into one stream (mode: append) so downstream logic runs once. Watch out: Waits for every configured input. If one branch never produces items, add 'Always Output Data' upstream so this doesn't stall.

nodes.name: Roll Up KPIs
nodes.notes: Group-by + aggregate (like a pivot table) — turns raw rows into KPI numbers.

nodes.name: Compose HTML Report
nodes.notes: Custom JavaScript: Build an HTML digest table from the aggregated rows Watch out: Must return an array of items shaped like [{ json: {...} }].

nodes.name: Send Report via Microsoft Teams
nodes.notes: Posts a chat message into a Microsoft Teams channel — same role as a Slack notify, for teams standardized on Teams. Retries 3x with 2s backoff before giving up. On failure the item leaves via the error output instead of stopping the run. Credential: Microsoft OAuth2. Azure Portal → App registrations → new app → add Microsoft Graph delegated permissions.

nodes.name: Guard Non-Empty amount
nodes.notes: Drops items that fail the condition; only qualifying items continue (no false branch).

nodes.name: Save Execution Metadata
nodes.notes: Saves key fields onto the execution record — searchable later in n8n's execution list.

nodes.name: Cap Batch Volume
nodes.notes: Caps the stream at 100 items to protect downstream quotas.

nodes.name: Stamp Processing Time
nodes.notes: Stamps processedAt with the current time for auditing.

nodes.name: Sort Invoices Newest First
nodes.notes: Orders items (newest first) so limits and digests pick the most relevant records.

nodes.name: Summarize Run Stats
nodes.notes: Shapes the item: writes runAt, itemCount, status. Keeps the schema explicit between stages.

nodes.name: Append Audit Row (MySQL)
nodes.notes: Inserts a row into the MySQL table using fields auto-mapped from the incoming item. Retries 3x with 2s backoff before giving up. On failure the item leaves via the error output instead of stopping the run. Credential: MySQL connection. Host, port, database, user, password from your MySQL provider.

parameters.content:
# Categorize receipts with MySQL and Microsoft Teams

**Pattern:** Expense Tracking · **Level:** Advanced · **Trigger:** Email

## What it does
Categorize receipts with MySQL and Microsoft Teams. It reacts to incoming email.

## Why it exists
Manual approvals is slow and error-prone; this workflow makes the process repeatable, monitored and hands-off, with failures surfaced instead of silently lost.

## Main flow
On New Email (IMAP) → Gather from MySQL → Blend Sources → Roll Up KPIs → Compose HTML Report → Send Report via Microsoft Teams → Guard Non-Empty amount → …

## Use it for
- Teams that want to expense tracking without manual effort
- Anyone automating approvals in finance
- Replacing a fragile manual process with a reliable workflow

## You get
- Has retries and error handling built in
- Keeps your systems in sync
- Removes copy-paste errors

## Before first run
Connect credentials: IMAP credentials; Microsoft OAuth2; MySQL connection; Slack OAuth2.
Follow the color key: 🟦 entry · 🟪 AI · 🟫 actions · ⬜ utilities · 🟩 outputs · 🟥 error rail.
Each node has its own doc card underneath — read those before editing.

## Try it now
Sample data is pinned on the trigger — hit **Execute Workflow** to watch it flow through every node before connecting any real credentials. Unpin the trigger (right-click → Unpin) when you're ready to go live.

## Design decisions

KPIs are rolled up with Summarize (exact group-by + aggregate) before any AI touches the data — asking an LLM to 'figure out the numbers' from raw records is slower, costlier, and less reliable than doing exact arithmetic in n8n and only asking the model to narrate numbers that are already correct.

## Practice exercises

You've got the basics covered — push further:

1. Add a second data source and watch it blend into the same report via Merge.
2. Toggle the AI executive-summary step on and off and compare the report's usefulness.
3. Change the KPI grouping field and see how the pivot reshapes.

## Credentials setup

Credentials are never included in a template file, so every node below needs its own connection before the first real run. In n8n: open the node, click the Credential dropdown, choose **Create new**.

**IMAP credentials**
IMAP host, port, user and password from your mail provider.
_Gotcha:_ Gmail requires an App Password and IMAP enabled in settings.

**MySQL connection**
Host, port, database, user, password from your MySQL provider.
_Gotcha:_ Remote access often needs the n8n server's IP allow-listed.

**Microsoft OAuth2**
Azure Portal → App registrations → new app → add Microsoft Graph delegated permissions.
_Gotcha:_ Graph throttles with HTTP 429 — the retry setting on this node already handles it.

**Slack OAuth2**
Slack API → Your Apps → create an app → OAuth & Permissions. n8n's Slack OAuth2 credential walks the install for you.
_Gotcha:_ Needs `chat:write`. Invite the bot to the channel or posting fails with `not_in_channel`.

Set each credential up once and it is reusable across every workflow in your instance.

## Troubleshooting

**Workflow does nothing when the trigger should fire**
Cause: It is still a draft, or the trigger is inactive.
Fix: Publish/activate the workflow. Manual test runs use a different URL than production.

**A node shows a red error triangle on import**
Cause: No credential is attached yet.
Fix: Expected on a fresh import — open the node and attach a credential (see the Credentials setup note).

**Execution stalls at the Merge node**
Cause: One input branch produced no items, so Merge is still waiting.
Fix: Enable 'Always Output Data' on the node feeding the empty branch.

**Database node cannot connect**
Cause: SSL not enabled, or the n8n server's IP is not allow-listed.
Fix: Most managed database providers require both.

Still stuck? n8n's **Executions** tab shows the exact node that failed and the data going into it — start there rather than guessing.

## 🛟 Error handling & retries

External calls retry **3× with 2s backoff**. Anything still failing exits through its node's error output into the red error rail → context is captured and the on-call channel is alerted. Set an n8n **Error Workflow** in settings as the final safety net.

## 🛠 Customize me

Quick wins: point the data nodes at your own accounts (see 🔑 lines on each card), adjust the trigger cadence, and tune thresholds/labels to your approvals process. Every node card explains its role — safe to extend at any marked branch.
